mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a plan of activities to be carried out in a class during the course of a day, a week or a term, nothing more and nothing less."
The lesson plan is a plan of activities to be carried out in a class during the course of a day, a week or a term, nothing more and nothing less.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an interactive process involving the teacher and the student or among the student themselves."
Discussion is an interactive process involving the teacher and the student or among the student themselves.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a pre-requisite for good citizenship."
The understanding of economics is a pre-requisite for good citizenship.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is concerned with the totality of the knowledge to be imparted in a lesson i.e. the content d."
The teacher is concerned with the totality of the knowledge to be imparted in a lesson i.e. the content d.

A lesson note is a plan or a guide; it is not as detailed as the notes we give to students.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the continuous assessment component of the course."
TMA is the continuous assessment component of the course.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a leader because of his administrative responsibilities in the school."
The school principal is a leader because of his administrative responsibilities in the school.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the most complicated evaluation instrument at the disposal of the teacher."
Essay test is the most complicated evaluation instrument at the disposal of the teacher.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is responsible for designing an educational instrument for the selection and recruitment of students, and staff as the case may be."
Economics teacher is responsible for designing an educational instrument for the selection and recruitment of students, and staff as the case may be.
